notes: rh.com is A-record only (no AAAA) so it is unreachable directly from this machine; translate.goog refuses the origin ('Can't translate this page'), so the whole extraction was done through the r.jina.ai reader proxy. Category tree taken from RH's own HTML site map (https://rh.com/us/en/sitemap) and cross-checked against https://rh.com/first-level-category-sitemap.xml (4460 category URLs), which confirms the canonical URL form /us/en/catalog/category/products.jsp/<catId>. QTY: not obtainable. RH product listing pages render nothing server-side (identical 45KB React shell for every categoryId, no embedded product JSON) and a headless render is met with a DataDome 'Verify you're human' CAPTCHA (confirmed by screenshot). The Apollo BFF at https://rh.com/graphql answers GET with only its landing page (Accept-header gated) and requires POST, which no available IPv6-reachable proxy can make - test.cors.workers.dev, allorigins, codetabs, corsfix, cors.lol all get DataDome-blocked on dynamic rh.com paths (only /static/ assets pass). RH also does not display a product count to human visitors on its category pages. All leaf rows therefore carry qty null + MANUAL REVIEW. SCOPE: RH sells no tabletop/dinnerware/glassware/drinkware/serveware and no clocks or vases as named categories (verified by keyword search over the full site map) - 'Vessels' under Decorative Accents is RH's vase category. Excluded: all furniture, rugs, textiles, pillows, throws, drapery, bedding, bath accessories, cabinet hardware, 'Greenery' (faux botanicals), 'Books', outdoor furniture/umbrellas/fire tables/fountains, sale pages, 'Collections' pages and 'All X' roll-up links. The parallel 'RH Estates' sub-brand duplicates of these same lighting/decor categories were treated as a brand line and omitted.
